There is a village in this country called 'Nederland'.

About six households, one road through it, and Wim Watt at every door with a free home battery. That is the whole twenty seconds. Kellerman @bureaukellerman came up with it, we produced it for them, and Horace Cohen @horacejcohen walks it.

A joke that small only survives if the place is real. So we shot in the actual village, in actual daylight, with the neighbours watching from their gardens.

A TVC for Next Energy. One month from the first meeting to delivery.

A farmhouse, a van and a lot of purple, all inside one street.

Shot so it could be cut to 30, 15 and 6 seconds.
